layout.behavior: Use large open fields interrupted by deliberate frames, crops and sequences.
layout.why: The composition should enact montage: fragments become a whole.
layout.use_when: Heroes, showcases, product storytelling, social and presentation layouts.
layout.avoid_when: Operational screens where clarity requires denser information.

typography.behavior: Large editorial serif for brand statements; restrained sans-serif for controls and explanation.
typography.why: Creates cinematic authorship without making the interface feel like a poster.
typography.use_when: Brand moments, definitions, section openings, end cards.
typography.avoid_when: Dense tables, form labels, technical metadata.

imagery.behavior: Show real moments in purposeful juxtaposition; never one generic stock hero pretending to represent montage.
imagery.why: The brand idea depends on visible plurality resolving into one composition.
imagery.use_when: Hero loops, examples, case studies, campaign surfaces.
imagery.avoid_when: If footage has no narrative relationship and becomes decorative noise.

motion.behavior: Frames enter separately, align on rhythm, then resolve into a stable composition. Cuts are default; dissolves are intentional exceptions.
motion.why: Motion should demonstrate editorial logic rather than decorate the interface.
motion.use_when: Hero sequence, logo sting, transitions between examples, export confirmation.
motion.avoid_when: Routine controls, reading-heavy surfaces, reduced-motion contexts.

interaction.behavior: System prepares; human reviews consequential output.
interaction.why: The product should remove editing labor without removing trust.
interaction.use_when: Selects, generated rough cuts, exports, publishing.
interaction.avoid_when: Never force review for reversible low-risk organization work.
